expected.NE_DECREASE: Less vasopressor support: the pressure it was supporting is expected to fall back.
expected.NE_INCREASE: More vasopressor support: the pressure may rise further while it runs. It does not replace volume and does not stop the bleeding.
expected.NE_START: A vasopressor supports the pressure while it runs. It does not replace volume and does not stop the bleeding.
expected.NE_STOP: The vasopressor support wears off: the pressure it was supporting is expected to fall back.
expected.blood: Red cells replace lost blood and support the pressure while they are given. They do not stop the bleeding.
expected.consult: A consultation is recorded: no change in the patient is modelled.
expected.consult_definitive: Definitive control of the bleeding is outside this development model: the encounter reaches its boundary.
expected.fluid: Crystalloid adds circulating volume for a while; part of it leaves the circulation. It does not stop the bleeding.
expected.ppi: Acid suppression: a modest reduction of the ongoing bleeding in this model. It is not control of the bleeding.
expected.vascular_access: Vascular access only: no change in the patient is modelled.

limitations.BLEEDING_NOT_CONTROLLED: The bleeding continues throughout this development encounter: no step controls it.
limitations.CONSCIOUSNESS_UNDER_TONE_UNRESOLVED: Consciousness under vasopressor support is not represented by the development model: the mental status the page shows comes from the legacy engine and is not evidence of resuscitation.
limitations.LEGACY_FIELDS_NOT_AUTHORITATIVE: Only the blood pressure is produced by the development authority. Heart rate, mental status and the other findings come from the legacy engine and are not part of this trace's readings.
limitations.OBSERVED_AT_REASSESSMENT_ONLY: The pressure is observed at the end of each turn; the minutes between two reassessments are not observed.
limitations.VASOPRESSOR_SUPPORT_IS_TEMPORARY: While the vasopressor runs, part of the pressure is vasopressor support: it is temporary and it is not control of the bleeding.

encounter.no_expectation: No expected physiological effect is represented for this action in the development model.

lines.label: Development boundary
lines.text: Development model boundary. This development encounter covers only the initial resuscitation of an upper gastrointestinal bleed, up to two hours after arrival. The bleeding has not been controlled in this encounter: definitive control of the bleeding source is outside this development model. Reaching this point does not mean that the patient has recovered, that the bleeding has stopped, that management is complete, or that discharge is safe.

limitations.text: The bleeding continues in every path: no path controls it, and every path ends at a development boundary before definitive control of the bleeding.

In the live development page, a consultation of gastroenterology can lead to an endoscopy performed by the simulator, with control of the bleeding. That course has never been reviewed and is outside this package (the development encounter ends at the request). Whether it may be reviewed, or must be blocked, is a faculty decision.

Consciousness under vasopressor support is not represented. The mental status the live page shows comes from the earlier engine: under a vasopressor it can stay normal while the pressure shown falls. It is not shown in this review and is not evidence of resuscitation.
Only the blood pressure is produced by the development model under review; heart rate, capillary refill and the other findings are not part of these trajectories.
The pressure response to red cells is at the low end of what was ratified for development (a monitored limitation, not recalibrated).

Without a stated reassessment interval, a turn lasts as long as what was given (two units of red cells hold the encounter for 60 minutes). Every path here states its reassessment interval, and the pressure is seen only at each reassessment.
How strongly the pressure response depends on the state of the pump is not yet validated: nothing here supports a vasopressor in pump-limited conditions.

Every path is a scripted development path: no resident typed these orders and no resident reasoning is shown. The scenario priorities and the categories are proposals for faculty review, not the faculty's and not a resident's.

statement: Synthetic development case. A faculty judgment of stored development paths of management of one upper gastrointestinal bleed, played through the development model: not a clinical validation, not a calibrated configuration, not a score, not a resident pilot.
what_it_is: Ten management paths of ONE upper gastrointestinal hemorrhage case from the same arrival, played through the live development authority of the GI pressure with manual norepinephrine: for each, the action sequence, the committed pressure trajectory, the management trace derived from the runtime events and the development boundary.
